newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle light at $72 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle light at $72 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow to moderate in the Panhandle area Friday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers steady. Feedlots reporting light to moderate inquiry from buyers. Sales confirmed on 7,100 slaughter steers and 1,500 heifers following the weekly movement of 78,900 head.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 72.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1150-1200 lbs 70.00.

Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 1050-1100 lbs 72.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1050-1100 lbs 70.50-71.00. Pen Select and Choice 2-4 1150 lbs including heiferettes 69.00. Confirmed - 8,600 Week Ago - None Year Ago - None
